_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ems__Bug cc7df026 — PropertiesLabelPatch invalidates the label index at once on metadataCache "changed"/"resolved" but re-patches open blocks only after a 300ms trailing debounce, instead of re-patching (and so rebuilding the whole-vault index for every unpatched key) on every event. Run from a COPY with the path placeholders replaced: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file>. Axis names are D<N> (this bug) and L<N>[a-z] (req 0a85d233), the FIRST token of each test title in PropertiesLabelPatch.test.ts.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/obsidian-plugin/src/presentation/properties/PropertiesLabelPatch.ts

M1_no_debounce._note: origin/main behaviour (every event re-patches, so every event rebuilds the index) — the base flip as a mutant.

M2_events_do_not_invalidate._note: No event invalidates the index any more: every axis that needs fresh metadata reds, L19 too (its new row resolves only through a rebuilt index).

M5_invalidation_deferred_to_the_repatch._note: The first revision of this fix (review round 1, two MEDIUM): the index stayed stale for the whole window, so a row the observer patched during it, or a re-enable after an event received while disabled, read the old label.
